description:
Check whether a new project has finished setting up and is ready to build.

    Returns overall (provisioning | ready | errored), a 7-stage checklist, and a
    user-facing error_kind when a stage failed. next_action is "wait" with
    poll_after_seconds (~10s) while provisioning, "wait" with NO
    poll_after_seconds when errored (fix the reported cause, then re-check —
    polling again without fixing it will not change the result), and "done" when
    overall is 'ready' — submit_request(project_id, text) then steers the loop.
    Reaching 'ready' also PERSISTS the owner's onboarding-completion
    state, so this is not a pure read. Tenant-scoped: a project not in the
    caller's workspace 404s.
name: get_provisioning_status
title: Get Provisioning Status
